All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
“Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
translations.bsb: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
translations.kjv: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
translations.asv: And Paul, looking stedfastly on the council, said, Brethren, I have lived before God in all good conscience until this day.
